name: Do you handle minor home modifications for disability and accessibility needs?

mainEntity.name: Do you handle minor home modifications for disability and accessibility needs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. In addition to drywall, tile, and carpentry repairs, HH Remodeling provides minor accessibility upgrades to make homes safer and easier to use. We install securely anchored grab bars, reinforce bathroom wall framing for shower safety, adjust interior door swings, widen standard doorway clearances, and install low-profile transition thresholds. As an owner-operated team, Abraham ensures all accessibility fixtures are securely tied into wall studs rather than relying on weak hollow-wall anchors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. We install securely anchored bathroom grab bars, adjust interior doorways, replace thresholds, and reinforce framing for greater home safety and accessibility.
